description_short: DistilBERT sentiment classifier for positive or negative movie reviews
description: This model analyzes movie reviews and predicts whether they express positive or negative sentiment. It follows the Hugging Face sequence-classification workflow: DistilBERT tokenizer, DistilBERT sequence classifier, fine-tuning on the IMDb reviews dataset, and local inference from saved model artifacts.

inputs.name: review_text
inputs.label: Movie Review Text
inputs.description: Raw text of a movie review in English. Can be any length — the model handles preprocessing automatically.

constraints.placeholder: This movie was absolutely fantastic! The acting was superb...

outputs.name: confidence
outputs.label: Prediction Confidence
outputs.description: Confidence score between 0 and 1, where higher values indicate more confident predictions

outputs.name: raw_score
outputs.label: Raw Model Output
outputs.description: Raw sigmoid output where values > 0.5 indicate positive sentiment, < 0.5 indicate negative sentiment
